name: neruva-record
summary: Auto-record AI agent activity into Neruva. v0.10 adds neruva-record-code-index CLI (Python ast + JS/TS via @neruva/js-extractor) + SessionStart auto-hook (NERUVA_AUTO_CODE_INDEX=1) for any pyproject/package.json/Cargo/go.mod project. Per-turn auto-recall (NERUVA_PER_TURN_RECALL=N). SessionStart auto-recall (NERUVA_AUTO_RECALL=N). Claude Code hook, claude-agent-sdk + Anthropic SDK wrappers. 14-pattern secrets redaction. Recalled-context prompt-injection guard.
